extra.message: The SPA catch-all route builds file_path = frontend_dist / path using the raw URL {path:path} segment and serves it via FileResponse when it exists. Because '../' sequences are not stripped, a request with path traversal segments (e.g. /../../etc/passwd) resolves outside frontend_dist and returns arbitrary files readable by the process.
